# 微软 FY26 Q4（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）三大业务分部完整分析报告

## 一、报告口径与数据来源

- **报告期**：FY26 Q4（Three Months Ended June 30, 2026），对比基期为 FY25 Q4（Three Months Ended June 30, 2025）。
- **金额单位**：百万美元（除特别说明外）。
- **主要来源**：
  - `press_release.txt`——FY26 Q4 业绩新闻稿（官方分部收入、同比增速及业务亮点）。
  - `financial_statements.txt` / `10k.txt`——分部财务明细表（Segment Results），含各分部收入、成本、经营费用、经营利润。
  - `transcript.txt`——FY26 Q4 业绩电话会管理层陈述（驱动因素与口径说明）。
- **口径提示**：
  - 微软分部报告采用**分部收入 / 分部成本 / 分部经营费用 / 分部经营利润**的四行结构，分部经营利润 = 分部收入 − 分部成本 − 分部经营费用。
  - 各分部"经营费用"仅含可直接归属或按合理基础分摊至该分部的费用，**不包含公司层面的合并 R&D/S&M/G&A**——但分部经营费用三行合计数（19,879M）与合并利润表 R&D+S&M+G&A（9,997+7,595+2,287 = 19,879M）完全一致，说明本季度公司全部经营性费用已全部分摊到三个分部，不存在未分摊的"公司层面"费用。
  - **分部经营利润之和 = 合并经营利润**，三个分部之间不存在公司层"其他"抵销项。
  - OpenAI 投资损益仅影响"Other income (expense), net"及净利润/EPS，**不影响分部经营利润**。
  - 微软同时披露 GAAP 与非 GAAP（剔除 OpenAI 投资损益），本报告分部数据为 GAAP 口径（与分部报告一致）。

## 三、增长/下滑驱动因素（引用电话会原文）

### 3.1 Productivity and Business Processes（收入 +14%，经营利润 +15%）

电话会（`transcript.txt`，Amy Hood 陈述段）：
- "Revenue from Productivity and Business Processes was $37.8 billion and grew 14%."
- **M365 Commercial 云**："M365 Commercial cloud revenue increased 16% on an adjusted basis when normalized for the prior-year comparable that benefited from 2 points of in-period revenue recognition. And on a reported basis, revenue growth was 14%."
- **Copilot 动能**："Building on our Copilot momentum from Q3, net paid seat adds more than doubled sequentially, with paid seats now over 30 million. Premium offerings, including Copilot, E5, and early traction in E7, drove ARPU growth this quarter."
- **M365 Commercial 本地产品**："M365 Commercial products revenue increased 19%, ahead of expectations driven by large, long-duration M365 contracts that resulted in higher in-period revenue recognition from the Windows Commercial on-premises component."
- **M365 Consumer**："M365 consumer cloud revenue increased 24% and 22% in constant currency, again driven by ARPU growth."
- **LinkedIn**："LinkedIn revenue increased 12% and 10% in constant currency primarily driven by Marketing Solutions."
- **Dynamics 365**："Dynamics 365 revenue increased 13% and 12% in constant currency against a strong prior-year comparable. Bookings growth in ERP remains healthy, while CRM continued to moderate with longer sales cycles."
- **利润率**："Segment gross margin dollars increased 14%…and gross margin percentage decreased slightly with increased M365 Copilot usage…Operating expenses increased 11% primarily driven by the shared R&D investments mentioned earlier. Operating income increased 15% and 14% in constant currency. And operating margins increased year-over-year to 58%."

### 3.2 Intelligent Cloud（收入 +32%，经营利润 +31%）

电话会（`transcript.txt`，Amy Hood 陈述段）：
- "Revenue was $39.3 billion and grew 32% and 31% in constant currency."
- **Azure**："In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity. Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized."
- **GitHub Copilot**："Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."
- **本地服务器**："In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts."
- **毛利率压力**："Segment gross margin dollars increased 24% and gross margin percentage decreased year-over-year primarily driven by sales mix shift to Azure, as well as the continued scaling of our AI infrastructure ahead of growing demand, partially offset by ongoing efficiency gains in Azure."
- **经营利润率**："Operating expenses increased 10% driven by the shared R&D investments noted earlier. Operating income grew 31% and operating margins…were relatively unchanged year-over-year at 41%."

### 3.3 More Personal Computing（收入 −4%，经营利润 −14%）

电话会（`transcript.txt`，Amy Hood 陈述段）：
- "Revenue was $12.9 billion and declined 4% and 5% in constant currency."
- **Windows OEM & Devices**："Windows OEM and Devices revenue decreased 7% and Windows OEM decreased 5% driven by lower PC market demand and a high prior-year comparable that benefited from Windows 10 end of support."
- **Search 广告**："Search advertising revenue ex-TAC increased 10% and 9% in constant currency with growth driven by higher revenue per search across Edge and Bing, as well as higher volume, though growth was impacted by third-party partnerships."
- **XBOX**："XBOX…revenue decreased 10% and 11% in constant currency. XBOX content and services revenue decreased 10% against a prior-year comparable that benefited from strong first-party content performance."
- **毛利率改善**："Segment gross margin dollars decreased 2% and gross margin percentage increased year-over-year driven by lower amortization from the Activision acquisition."
- **经营利润率下降**："Operating expenses increased 8% and 7% in constant currency driven by the continued investments in shared R&D noted earlier as well as impairment charges in XBOX. Operating income decreased 14% and 15% in constant currency and operating margins decreased year-over-year to 21%。"

## 四、全公司合计数与勾稽验证

### 4.1 合并利润表（FY26 Q4）

| 项目 | FY26 Q4 | FY25 Q4 | 同比 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 总收入 | $90,007M | $76,441M | +18% |
| 收入成本 | $29,525M | $24,014M | +22.9% |
| 毛利 | $60,482M | $52,427M | +15.4% |
| 经营费用合计 | $19,879M | $18,104M | +9.8% |
| 经营利润 | $40,603M | $34,323M | +18.3% |

> 数据出处：`press_release.txt` → Income Statements 表（Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 列）；`financial_statements.txt` → "Income Statements" 工作表。

### 4.2 三分部之和与合计勾稽验证

| 项目 | PBP + IC + MPC 合计 | 合并报告数 | 是否一致 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 收入 | 37,847 + 39,306 + 12,854 = **90,007** | 90,007 | ✅ 一致 |
| 收入成本 | 6,989 + 16,876 + 5,660 = **29,525** | 29,525 | ✅ 一致 |
| 经营费用 | 8,958 + 6,475 + 4,446 = **19,879** | 19,879 | ✅ 一致 |
| 经营利润 | 21,900 + 15,955 + 2,748 = **40,603** | 40,603 | ✅ 一致 |

> 数据出处：`financial_statements.txt` → "Segment Results" 工作表 Total 区块（Q4'26 列），与三大分部子项分别相加完全吻合。

**结论**：三个分部收入、成本、经营费用、经营利润分别加总后，与合并利润表对应项目**完全勾稽一致**，不存在任何未分摊公司费用或跨分部抵销项。这意味着合并经营利润 $40,603M 可以精确拆解为三个分部经营利润之和（$21,900M + $15,955M + $2,748M）。

## 六、关键口径提示（读者使用数字时需注意）

1. **分部经营利润 ≠ 分部毛利 − 公司 R&D/S&M/G&A**。微软将全部 $19,879M 经营性费用（等于合并 R&D+S&M+G&A）分摊到三个分部，因此分部经营利润之和直接等于合并经营利润。这与部分同业"分部利润 + 公司费用"的列示不同，**切勿重复扣减公司层费用**。

2. **分部毛利率不可直接横向比较**。PBP 毛利率 81.5%（以授权/订阅为主）远高于 IC 57.1% 与 MPC 56.0%（含大量云基础设施与硬件成本）。毛利率差异反映的是业务模式差异，而非经营效率优劣。

3. **Azure 收入是 IC 分部的子集，不在分部表中单列金额**。Azure 同比 +43%，但 Azure 金额被包含在 IC 分部收入 $39,306M 内部（与本地服务器、GitHub 等合并列示）。`metrics.txt` 仅披露 Azure 增速，不披露 Azure 绝对金额，**不可将 Azure 增速等同于 IC 分部增速**。

4. **OpenAI 投资损益不影响分部经营利润**。FY26 Q4 因 Anthropic 投资产生 $3.2B 一次性收益（`press_release.txt`），该收益计入"Other income (expense), net"，使 GAAP 净利润/EPS 显著高于非 GAAP，**但不进入分部经营利润**。分部数据仅反映经营性业务。

5. **M365 Commercial 云收入存在基数效应**。FY25 Q4 同期受益于 2 个百分点的"期内收入确认"，因此 FY26 Q4 报告口径下 M365 Commercial 云增速 14%，但调整后口径为 16%。`metrics.txt` 同时列示 GAAP/恒定汇率双口径（14% / 14%），表明汇率对 M365 Commercial 云无显著影响。

6. **恒定汇率口径**。`press_release.txt` 披露：公司整体收入恒定汇率增速 17%（vs GAAP 18%），IC 恒定汇率 31%（vs GAAP 32%），MPC 恒定汇率 −5%（vs GAAP −4%），PBP 恒定汇率 14%（与 GAAP 一致）。IC 与 MPC 受汇率小幅扰动，PBP 几乎不受影响。

7. **分部历史数据存在重述**。`financial_statements.txt` 注明"We have recast certain prior period amounts to conform to the current period presentation"，FY25 Q4 分部数已按 FY25 8 月公布的分部结构调整重述，**与原始 FY25 Q4 财报可能略有差异**，本报告统一采用重述后数据。

8. **电话会中"经营利润率"表述与分部表略有出入**。Amy Hood 在电话会中称 PBP "operating margins increased year-over-year to 58%"、IC "relatively unchanged year-over-year at 41%"、MPC "decreased year-over-year to 21%"，均为四舍五入值；分部表精确值为 57.9%、40.6%、21.4%，请以分部表为准。

---

## 七、总结

FY26 Q4 微软三大分部呈现"**一升一稳一降**"格局：
- **Intelligent Cloud** 为增长引擎（收入 +32%、经营利润 +31%），Azure +43% 持续超预期，但 AI 基础设施扩张导致毛利率承压 −3.3 pp，经营利润率因费用控制持平于 40.6%。
- **Productivity and Business Processes** 稳健增长（收入 +14%、经营利润 +15%），Copilot 付费席位突破 3000 万、ARPU 提升推动经营利润率扩张至 57.9%，是利润率最高的分部。
- **More Personal Computing** 唯一下滑（收入 −4%、经营利润 −14%），受 Windows OEM 需求疲软与 XBOX 内容高基数拖累，XBOX 减值进一步压制利润，经营利润率降至 21.4%。

三个分部加总后与合并利润表**完全勾稽**，数据可信、可复核。
